rust_summary: A bounded client view raycast using crosshair block and entity picking.
doc_summary: `client_view_hit(max_distance)` returns a block face or entity and the world-space hit position during a client frame. The distance must be finite, positive, and at most 128 blocks. It shares the eight-query per-mod frame budget with `crosshair_entity`; an entity UUID can be unavailable. Requires native hooks API @API:view_raycast@.
